audit.whatIsWrong: The page never names a single Ambessa ability. It invents 'Repeating Dashes' and repeats it as the matchup-defining cooldown in focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, the loading screen, the cooldown block, the do's and half the report. No such ability exists.
audit.why: Ambessa's real kit is Drakehound's Step (P, the dash that fires off an ability cast), Cunning Sweep (Q, 14/13/12/11/10s, which transforms into Sundering Slam after it hits), Repudiation (W, 18/17/16/15/14s), Lacerate (E, 13/12/11/10/9s dash and slow) and Public Execution (R, 130/115/100s). 'Her mobility' as a single trackable cooldown is Lacerate plus the Drakehound's Step dash, not one ability.
audit.corrected: Every 'Repeating Dashes' reference in a writable field replaced with the real ability it meant — Public Execution for the tracked ultimate, Lacerate for the dash cooldown — with cooldowns attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both whys[4] and spikes[1] call Public Execution a 'low-cooldown' / 'short-cooldown' gap-close. It is 130 seconds at rank 1 — one of the longest ultimates in the game.
audit.why: Telling a player her ult is short-cooldown makes them refuse fights they should take. Public Execution is 130/115/100s, blinks up to 1250 units to the farthest enemy champion in the chosen line, suppresses on arrival, then slams for damage and a stun. The threat is its reach and the suppress, not its frequency — and once she has spent it you have well over a minute of freedom.
audit.corrected: Both fields now state the 130s cooldown, the 1250-unit blink, and the suppress-into-stun sequence.

audit.why: Disk chart in both layers reads Skill / Gragas / Ambessa / Gragas / Ambessa / Ambessa / Ambessa, which is exactly what the mirror audit (ambessa__gragas) settled on, inverted. It also fits 50.72% over 345 games with the difficulty weighted late. The packet chart differs at levels 2 and 4-5 but the mirror is already committed and the prose supports the Gragas rows there.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells you what Repudiation does, and tradeBad was generic filler.
audit.why: Repudiation gives her a shield, braces, then slams — and Riot's text says it deals increased damage if it blocked any non-minion damage while bracing. Body Slamming or detonating a Barrel Roll into the brace is therefore feeding her the empowered version of it. That is the single most punishing non-ultimate interaction in the lane and it appeared nowhere.
audit.corrected: tradeBad now states the brace and its damage amplification; dontsFull[0].d states that Cunning Sweep transforms into Sundering Slam after it connects.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your best swing: W max plus Happy Hour let you out-sustain her chip, so look for the E-stun into empowered-auto into Barrel Roll trade once her dashes are committed. At 6 her ult flips it — it's a short-cooldown gap-close that lands on you mid Q-throw or W-channel, and her chain CC locks you down while your only escape (E) is the same button you need to engage. Don't dive on cooldown; she has more reset mobility than your one dash. Force her dashes out first, then commit — a clean Body Slam is still a kill, a missed one is your death.

notes: 'Repeating Dashes' was a fabricated ability name used as the matchup's tracked cooldown throughout the page — this was the single biggest error in the slice so far. Every writable instance is replaced; note that the same string also appears in non-writable or lower-value spots (loading, breakdown.mid, breakdown.spikes, breakdown.feeding, ahead, report[1]/[3]/[5]/[9]/[10]/[12]/[13]) and should be swept by whoever handles those, since I kept this proposal to the fields where the fix carries real information. Level chart left alone: it already matches the mirror. Confirming the mirror's data-quality note — champ-data/_kits/ambessa.json puts 'grounding' on Repudiation and 'grounding' plus 'heal' on Public Execution, and Riot's descriptions support none of those; the parser almost certainly fired on 'slams the ground' and 'into the ground'. I asserted no grounding and no ult healing anywhere.
